caption: Three awaits on one pooled connection: the pool fills each ? and hands the connection back after every reply, so the app only ever sees the result — insertId 11 with 3 rows, then Asha and Chandan, then affectedRows 1 and changedRows 1.

spec.aria: The Node app sends an INSERT, a SELECT and an UPDATE one after another to the mysql2 pool; the pool binds each ? and runs the statement on MySQL, MySQL replies with 3 rows and insertId 11, then 2 names Asha and Chandan, then affectedRows 1 and changedRows 1, and the connection returns to the pool after each reply.
